## Эксперименты

- drag-lexical-routing-ab-2026-11-06: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. 5 seeds, 84 synthetic DBA documents and 60 query-classified requests per seed, 4 arms and equal top-3 output budget. Recall@3 baseline 47.0%, adaptive 63.3%, always-deep 63.3%, matched-deep-count random 57.0%; adaptive 36/60 expensive routes vs always 60/60. All arms falsely cite documents on 12/12 no-match queries per seed. Adaptive multi-hop complete-evidence rate 0%. CPU/wall/p95/RAM/IO measured, all query outputs and gold labels archived; deterministic replay and mutated oracle checked. Not authors published DRAG code, QPP, perplexity or SFT; synthetic self-authored corpus and gold with alias glossary favor expanded retrieval. No human blind oracle or project benefit; no LLM calls, tokens/VRAM N/A, API cost 0. No-match and multi-hop negative controls fail, NOT approved for integration. [Артефакт](../../experiments/2026-11-06-drag-retrieval-depth-ab.py) · [Артефакт](../../data/results/drag/2026-11-06-retrieval-depth-ab.json) · [Артефакт](../../reviews/drag/2026-11-06-retrieval-ab.md)
- drag-evidence-guard-holdout-ab-2026-11-06: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. 3 dev seeds choose threshold 1.0 before 5 sealed new seed holdouts 20261211-15. 96 generated docs and 84 queries per seed, 180 positives/240 negatives total. Five arms on same BM25; baseline recall@3 75%, complete 66.7%, negative abstention 0%, citation precision 14.3%; schema+linked-runbook 100% on all these synthetic metrics, +10.7% CPU/wall. Wrong-link negative fails as expected; original first run invalidated and archived. Not original DRAG; in-memory graph by direct link rather than second ranked retrieval, and exact machine-readable metadata built with same schema across calibration and holdout. Only synthetic oracle, no independent human labels. Tokens/VRAM N/A and API cost 0 due no model calls; do not transfer scores. [Артефакт](../../experiments/2026-11-06-drag-abstention-multihop-ab.py) · [Артефакт](../../experiments/tests/test_drag_evidence_gate.py) · [Артефакт](../../data/results/drag/2026-11-06-abstention-multihop-ab.json) · [Артефакт](../../data/results/drag/2026-11-06-invalidated-parser-run.json) · [Артефакт](../../reviews/drag/2026-11-06-evidence-gate-ab.md)
- drag-evidence-gate-ood-stress-2026-11-06: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. Posthoc adversarial stress on five new seeds 20261231-35: baseline vs frozen schema+link guard. kind= to kind: format shift preserves BM25 top-3, but guarded positive coverage drops to 0% while negative abstention stays 100%. Inserting four forged schema-compatible observation docs per incident drops guard citation precision to 0%, positive coverage to 66.7%. Explicitly severe synthetic stress and not a blind holdout. Not representative incident frequency or trusted-source corpus; spoofed documents injected with 4:1 prevalence and no content provenance. Same-script synthetic oracle, no original DRAG models or real project data. Token and VRAM metrics N/A.
